area: EDGE-wide round-2 changes on every page but Sector (shell, Overview, Watchlist, Radar, Screener, Backtest, Admin)
checked: Terminal untouched: git diff 53b4fafb..HEAD -- apps/edge-bff/terminal is 0 lines.

Own run of verification/edge_states/round2_focus_contrast.mjs (6 pages + shell, light+dark): all focus, contrast, touch and name steps pass except Radar touch (below). Its sector steps fail ('no expand button in view', both themes) but that is the Sector checkers' area and the script hardcodes sector.

Focus, own probe (probe_focus.mjs): per page and theme, 160 Tab stops (and 900 on Overview/Radar/Watchlist/Screener/shell) plus a mouse click on up to 120 focusables, reading the rendered outline, box-shadow and border colours of the focused element and its :focus-within ancestors. Blue focus states found: 0 on all pages and the shell sign-in; mouse clicks leave 0 rings; no text field takes an outline; ring colour is the grey (107/138). The only blue-bordered focused elements are the filled blue CTAs 'Add indicator' (Screener .top-add, Backtest #xsAdd), whose blue is their normal fill, not a focus state.
Fields: Watchlist, Backtest, Screener, Admin show decision 8 (transparent border + soft shadow). Overview and Radar fields show a 1px grey line and no shadow (EW2-2).

Shell: only the sign-in page can be rendered. For the logged-in components I injected elements with the real class names (.settings-select select, .compare-search>div, label.search, .composer) into the real static/index.html stylesheet: three show a 3px grey ring (EW2-1).

Contrast, own scan (probe_contrast.mjs) of every text node whose colour is --text-3, a tag ink or that sits on a tint, default state plus up to 14 tab/segment states per page: no pair below 4.5 except text-3 text drawn at reduced opacity (EW2-3). Hover scan (probe_hc.mjs): only blue --blue text on blue hover tints in Backtest (EW2-4); the rest are heat tiles / up-down numbers, which are unchanged by the decision, and artefacts of my hover-bg walk. --green/--red/--blue/--amber token values identical pre vs new on all six pages; .up/.down still use --green/--red.

Touch (probe_touch.mjs, probe_overlap.mjs, 390x844 and 360x740, hasTouch+isMobile): measured the real tap extent with elementFromPoint and the enlarged ::after/::before boxes of every shared control. Overview, Watchlist, Screener, Backtest, Admin: no overlap of enlarged areas; Radar: 8 overlapping pairs (EW2-5).

Names: fixtures served with 'Pt ...' show 'PT ...' (Watchlist, Screener, Backtest; also seen in crops crop_watchlist_*, crop_screener_*). Source review: every reader of a publisher name field goes through shared/company-name.ts; rule is startsWith('Pt ') only, so 'PT Bank' and 'Alpha Pt Beta' stay. Screener CSV export keeps the source text (download, not display) - by design.

Collateral damage: built the pre-change tree (git worktree at 46691b5d in scratch, fixtures built with symlinked node_modules and the local Radar/Overview data) and compared 6 pages x light/dark x 1384/390 (48 shots + element geometry). Element geometry identical on all (0 moved) except the Watchlist name span that got wider (Pt -> PT, 131.3 -> 135.1 px, expected). Structural pixel diff (edge map) is 0 on Admin, Backtest, Overview, Radar; Screener 62 px and Watchlist 197 px, both only the Pt -> PT names. Everything else differs only by colour (text-3 / tag inks). Hover state of up to 140 controls per page: no hover effect lost or gained (computed colours/shadow/transform), 0 differences.
Own page tests (vitest, read-only): overview 28, watchlist 26, radar 9, backtest 107, admin 15 all pass; screener run pending at time of writing, see not_checked/last line if it finished.

findings.title: Radar stacked segment rows: enlarged touch areas overlap by 8 px and each button's real tap area is only 36 px (rows 1-2) / 42 px (row 3), not 44
findings.where: Radar, 390x844 and 360x740, touch, with the local data (3 stacked .seg.sm rows: Broad/Liquid, Loose/Standard/Tight, All hits/New today...); light
findings.steps: Open /radar-app/ with hasTouch+isMobile on the fixture with data; read each .seg button's ::after box (top/bottom -11px, 44 px tall) and elementFromPoint along its vertical axis (probe_overlap.mjs, probe_touch.mjs, radar_seg.mjs).
findings.expected: UD72 3A: 44 x 44 px tap area, no layout change, and 'no two areas overlapping' (--hit-y halfway to the neighbour).
findings.actual: Rows sit at a 36 px pitch (seg 28 px high, buttons 22 px), the default --hit-y 22px is not capped for this stack, so the ::after boxes of neighbouring rows overlap (8 pairs, 8 px each); the later element wins, leaving 36x(44 wide) for rows 1-2 and 42 for the last. Real data not needed beyond the local fixture. Fix without layout change: set --hit-y:7px on those rows (36 px, no overlap); 44 would need a row pitch of 44 or fewer rows.
findings.evidence: round2_focus_contrast.mjs 'radar: touch hit areas' FAIL: button.on 48x22 hit 48x36 ... ; probe_overlap.mjs: 8 overlapping pairs at 390 and 360; radar/src/styles/radar.css:945-950 (.seg{--hit-x:0px} only).

findings.title: Screener preset segment buttons keep a 30 px tap height inside their own scroller
findings.where: Screener, 390x844 touch, the '.seg.sm' preset row (buttons 26 px)
findings.steps: round2_focus_contrast.mjs prints 'cut by their own scroller: button.on 35x26 in span.seg.sm: 35x30'; radar_seg.mjs shows the ::after at -9px but the row (span.seg.sm, 32 px high, overflow scroll) clips it.
findings.expected: 44 px tap height where the row allows.
findings.actual: 30 px; the scroller's overflow clips the enlarged area. Known open item, confirmed; the only no-layout-change refinement is none (the clip is the row's own height). Also uncovered by the shared list but under 44: Watchlist button.symb 18 px, Screener .ficon 30x30, .qf 32 px, Backtest .bh-btn 28x28, #btab* 36 px, .xinfo 18 px (not in the decision 14 list, so not a defect).
